name: nawras/arcade
description: Bilingual RTL-first arcade engine: one codebase, PHP 8.3 dynamic + static export, licence ledger with an audit trail, bucketed leaderboard (8 CloudArcade-compatible period types), SSRF-hardened providers and schema migrations.

suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Production installs run on MySQL; pdo_sqlite is enough for the zero-config quick start.
suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Needed for the sqlite driver and for the installer's self-check on shared hosts.
suggest.ext-intl: Only if you add locale-aware sorting to the leaderboard.

scripts-descriptions.gates: Runs every structural + executable gate. The Python tools are the reviewer because a PHP runtime is not guaranteed on the machine doing the review.
scripts-descriptions.install-site: Writes config, migrates the schema and seeds the admin account.
scripts-descriptions.export-static: Writes the static bundle for games the licence auditor cleared for redistribution.
